title: Add Hero Section
content: Create impactful hero section component. Full-width container with generous padding (py-20 lg:py-32). Layout options: centered text, split with image right, or background image with overlay. Content: headline using text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold with proper line-height, subheadline in text-xl text-gray-600, CTA buttons (primary filled + secondary outline) with proper spacing. Add background: gradient, pattern, image with dark overlay for text contrast. Include optional elements: trust badges, customer logos, stats row, announcement banner above. Animated entrance for text elements. Responsive: stack elements on mobile, adjust text sizes. Consider video background option.

variants.simple: Create an impactful hero section with headline, description, and CTAs.

variants.advanced: Create impactful hero section component with multiple layout variants and polish. Container: relative overflow-hidden, min-h-[600px] or min-h-screen for full viewport. Inner: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-20 lg:py-32. Layout variants: 1) Centered: text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto, 2) Split: grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center with content left/image right, 3) Background image: relative with absolute bg-image and overlay. Headline: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-gray-900 (or text-white on dark bg), proper line-height leading-tight. Subheadline: mt-6 text-lg sm:text-xl text-gray-600 max-w-2xl (for readability). CTA buttons: mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4, primary (bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-lg font-medium), secondary (border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 px-8 py-3 rounded-lg). Background options: gradient (bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50), pattern (SVG or CSS pattern), image with bg-cover bg-center and dark overlay (bg-black/50). Trust indicators: flex items-center gap-8 mt-12, customer logos in grayscale hover:grayscale-0. Stats row: grid grid-cols-3 gap-8 mt-12 with large numbers + labels. Announcement banner: above hero with dismissible promo message. Floating elements: decorative shapes, screenshots, or illustrations with subtle parallax. Image in split layout: relative rounded-lg shadow-xl overflow-hidden, optional floating UI elements. Video background: autoPlay loop muted playsInline with poster fallback. Animation: staggered fade-in for text elements using CSS animation delays. Responsive: stack to single column on mobile, adjust text sizes and padding. ACCESSIBILITY: proper heading level (h1), sufficient color contrast on overlays, ensure text readable on all backgrounds.
